spells.name: Arcane Eye
spells.description: Create an Invisible, invulnerable eye that hovers. Mentally receive visual info; it has 30ft Darkvision. Bonus Action: move it 30ft. Can pass through 1-inch openings.

spells.name: Aura of Life
spells.description: You and allies in the 30ft Emanation have Resistance to Necrotic damage and max HP cannot be reduced. Allies with 0 HP starting their turn in aura regain 1 HP.

spells.name: Aura of Purity
spells.description: You and allies in the 30ft Emanation have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves vs: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.description: Target makes a Charisma save. Fail: banished to a harmless demiplane (Incapacitated) or its home plane (if from elsewhere). If it stays 1 minute and is from elsewhere, it doesn't return.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 4.

spells.name: Blight
spells.description: Creature makes a Constitution save. Fail: 8d8 Necrotic damage. Success: half damage. Plants fail automatically. Non-creature plants simply wither.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 4.

spells.name: Charm Monster
spells.description: Creature makes a Wisdom save (Advantage if you/allies are fighting it). Fail: Charmed for duration or until damaged. It is Friendly to you. Target knows it was Charmed.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 4.

spells.name: Compulsion
spells.description: Chosen creatures make a Wisdom save. Fail: on its turn, must move in a direction you choose (Bonus Action) before moving normally. Cannot move into obvious hazards.

spells.name: Confusion
spells.description: 10ft-radius Sphere. Each creature makes a Wisdom save. Fail: target rolls d10 at start of turns: 1-4: move random direction; 5-6: no move/action; 7-8: melee attack random creature or do nothing; 9-10: act normally. Repeat save at end of turns.
spells.upcast: Radius increases by 5 feet for each level above 4.

spells.name: Conjure Minor Elementals
spells.description: Elemental spirits surround you. Your Speed increases by 10ft. When you hit a creature within 15ft with an attack, deal an extra 2d8 damage (Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning). Area within 15ft is Difficult Terrain for enemies.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 2d8 for each level above 4.

spells.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
spells.description: Fey spirits surround you. You have Advantage on saving throws vs spells. When you move into an enemy's space or they enter/start turn in aura: Wisdom save or take 5d8 Force damage (once/turn).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 4.

spells.name: Control Water
spells.description: Control water in a 100ft Cube. Choose: Flood (rise 20ft), Part Water (trench), Redirect (flow change), or Whirlpool (Dex save or 2d8 Bludgeoning and Restrained).

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.description: Touch a creature. First time it would drop to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead and spell ends. Negates one instant death effect.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.description: Teleport yourself and one willing creature (size M-) to a spot within range. You can bring objects up to your carrying capacity. Fails if space is occupied (take 4d6 Force damage).

spells.name: Divination
spells.description: Ask one question concerning a goal/event within 7 days. DM gives a truthful reply (cryptic rhyme/omen). Cumulative 25% failure chance if cast >1/Long Rest.

spells.name: Dominate Beast
spells.description: Beast makes a Wisdom save. Fail: Charmed and you have a telepathic link. Use a Magic action to take total control of its next turn. Repeat save on damage (Advantage).
spells.upcast: Duration: 10m (L5), 1h (L6), 8h (L7+).

spells.name: Evard's Black Tentacles
spells.description: 20ft square of tentacles (Difficult Terrain). Creatures in/entering make a Strength save. Fail: 3d6 Bludgeoning damage and Restrained. Target takes 3d6 damage if it starts turn Restrained. Action to break free (Str/Dex check).

spells.name: Fabricate
spells.description: Convert raw materials into a finished product. Can't create magic items. Requires appropriate tool proficiency for complex items. Scale: 10ft Cube (minerals) or 8 Medium- objects (other materials).

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.description: Choose Warm (Resistance to Cold) or Chill (Resistance to Fire). Any creature hitting you with a melee attack within 5ft takes 2d8 damage (Fire for Warm, Cold for Chill). Sheds 10ft Bright Light (+10ft Dim).

spells.name: Fount of Moonlight
spells.description: You glow with moonlight (20ft Bright, +20ft Dim). Gain Resistance to Radiant damage and your melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 Radiant damage. When hit by melee, use a Reaction to force a Constitution save or Blind the attacker until your next turn.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.description: Willing creature ignores Difficult Terrain. Magic cannot reduce its Speed or cause it to be Paralyzed or Restrained. Spend 5ft movement to auto-succeed on escaping nonmagical restraints (manacles/grapples). No penalty for underwater movement/combat.

spells.name: Giant Insect
spells.description: Transform 1-10 insects into Giant versions (Centipede, Spider, Wasp, or Scorpion). They obey commands and share your Initiative (act after you). Stat blocks scale with level.

spells.name: Grasping Vine
spells.description: Conjure a vine. Bonus Action: pull a creature within 30ft of vine toward it. Target makes a Dexterity save or is pulled 20ft.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.description: Touch a creature to grant it the Invisible condition. The spell doesn't end if it attacks or casts spells.

spells.name: Guardian of Faith
spells.description: Summon a Large spectral guardian. When an enemy moves within 10ft: Dexterity save or take 20 Radiant damage (half on success). Guardian vanishes after dealing 60 total damage.

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
spells.description: Make 150ft Cube area look/sound/smell like different natural terrain. Doesn't affect buildings/creatures. Study action (Investigation) vs spell DC to see through.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.description: 40ft-high, 20ft-radius Cylinder. Creatures make a Dexterity save. Fail: 2d8 Bludgeoning + 4d6 Cold damage. Success: half damage. Area is Difficult Terrain until your next turn.
spells.upcast: Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d8 per level above 4.

spells.name: Leomund's Secret Chest
spells.description: Hide a 3x2x2ft chest on the Ethereal Plane. Use a Magic action to recall/return it via a replica. Cumulative 5% daily failure chance after 60 days.

spells.name: Locate Creature
spells.description: Sense direction to a familiar creature within 1,000ft. Can locate specific creatures seen within 30ft or the nearest kind. Blocked by lead or 10ft wide running water.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
spells.description: Summon a phantom watchdog (invisible/intangible). Barks if creature comes within 30ft without password. It has 30ft Truesight. At start of your turn, it bites one enemy within 5ft: Dexterity save or 4d8 Force damage. Move it 30ft as a Magic action. Ends if you are >300ft away.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
spells.description: Secure a Cube (5-100ft side). Choose: sound blocked, barrier dark/foggy, sensors blocked, creatures can't be targeted by Divination, or planar travel blocked. Lasts until dispelled if cast in same spot for 1 year.

spells.name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
spells.description: Enclose a creature or object in a sphere of force. Target makes a Dexterity save. Fail: target is trapped. Nothing can pass through. Trapped creatures can use an Action to roll the sphere (half Speed).

spells.name: Phantasmal Killer
spells.description: Manifest a creature's deepest fear. Target makes a Wisdom save. Fail: Frightened for duration. At start of each of its turns, it takes 4d10 Psychic damage. Repeat save at end of its turns.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d10 per level above 4.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.description: Transform a creature into a Beast (CR max = target CR/level). Unwilling targets make a Wisdom save. Target gains Temporary HP equal to the new form's HP. When Temp HP reach 0, it reverts. Cannot cast or speak. Gear merges.

spells.name: Staggering Smite
spells.description: Take as a Bonus Action immediately after hitting with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. Target takes extra 4d6 Psychic damage and makes a Wisdom save. Fail: Stunned until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Stone Shape
spells.description: Form stone (Medium- or 5ft section) into any shape. Can create passages or doors (max 2 hinges/latch).

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.description: Touch a willing creature: it gains Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

spells.name: Summon Aberration
spells.description: Summon an Aberrant Spirit (Beholderkin, Mind Flayer, or Slaad). It shares your initiative (acts after you). Stat block scales with level.
spells.upcast: Stat block scales with spell level.

spells.name: Summon Construct
spells.description: Summon a Construct Spirit (Clay, Metal, or Stone). It shares your initiative (acts after you). Stat block scales with level.
spells.upcast: Stat block scales with spell level.

spells.name: Summon Elemental
spells.description: Summon an Elemental Spirit (Air, Earth, Fire, or Water). It shares your initiative (acts after you). Stat block scales with level.
spells.upcast: Stat block scales with spell level.

spells.name: Vitriolic Sphere
spells.description: 20ft-radius Sphere of acid. Each creature makes a Dexterity save. Fail: 10d4 Acid damage and 5d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. Success: half of initial damage and no subsequent damage.
spells.upcast: Initial damage increases by 2d4 per level above 4.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.description: Create a wall of fire (60ft long, 20ft high, 1ft thick OR 20ft-radius ring). One side deals damage. Creatures in area when cast make a Dexterity save or take 5d8 Fire damage (half on success). Creature takes damage when it enters the wall or ends its turn within 10ft of the hot side.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 per level above 4.

spells.name: Elemental Bane
spells.description: Choose a creature and a damage type (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder). Target makes a Constitution save. Fail: loses Resistance to that type. Also, the first time it takes damage of that type each turn, it takes an extra 2d6 damage.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature (within 30ft) for each level above 4.

spells.name: Find Greater Steed
spells.description: Summon a powerful spirit mount (Griffon, Pegasus, Peryton, Dire Wolf, Rhinoceros, or Saber-toothed Tiger). It is a Celestial, Fey, or Fiend. Shares telepathic link (1 mile). Spells you cast targeting only yourself also affect the mount within 5ft.

spells.name: Galder's Speedy Courier
spells.description: Summon a Small air elemental to deliver an object (max 5 lbs) to a creature you know on the same plane. Elemental vanishes after 1 round or upon delivery.
spells.upcast: Object weight increases by 10 lbs per level above 4.

spells.name: Gravity Sinkhole
spells.description: 20ft-radius Sphere. Each creature makes a Constitution save. Fail: 5d10 Force damage and pulled to the center. Success: half damage and no movement.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d10 per level above 4.

spells.name: Guardian of Nature
spells.description: Transform into a nature guardian. Choose: **Primal Beast** (+10ft Speed, 120ft Darkvision, Adv on Str attacks, extra 1d6 Force damage on hits) or **Great Tree** (10 Temp HP, Adv on Con saves, Adv on Dex/Wis attacks, 15ft aura of Difficult Terrain).

spells.name: Raulothim's Psychic Lance
spells.description: Lance of psychic energy. Target creature (can name it to bypass cover/sight) makes an Intelligence save. Fail: 7d6 Psychic damage and Incapacitated until your next turn. Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 per level above 4.

spells.name: Shadow of Moil
spells.description: Flame-like shadows surround you. You are Heavily Obscured to others. Gain Resistance to Radiant damage. When hit by a creature within 10ft, it takes 2d8 Necrotic damage.

spells.name: Sickening Radiance
spells.description: 30ft-radius Sphere of green light. Creatures entering or starting turns inside make a Constitution save. Fail: 4d10 Radiant damage, one level of Exhaustion, and emits light (no Invisibility). Success: half damage and no exhaustion. Exhaustion ends when spell ends.

spells.name: Storm Sphere
spells.description: 20ft-radius Sphere of wind/lightning. Each creature inside makes a Strength save or takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage. Area is Difficult Terrain. Bonus Action: lightning bolt to creature within 60ft (Advantage if inside sphere) for 4d6 Lightning damage.
spells.upcast: Both damages increase by 1d6 per level above 4.

spells.name: Summon Greater Demon
spells.description: Summon a demon (CR 5 or lower). It makes a Charisma save at the end of its turns (Disadv if you know its true name). Fail: obeys you. Success: it acts independently and attacks nearby non-demons. It disappears 1d6 rounds after Concentration ends.
spells.upcast: CR increases by 1 for every level above 4.

spells.name: Watery Sphere
spells.description: 10ft-radius Sphere of water. Creatures inside make a Strength save. Fail: Restrained and carried by the sphere. Action to move sphere 30ft. If it moves into a new creature's space, they make the save.
